text:
Situation: Midazolam hydrochloride has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2020-04-02 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Both Corvale East and Corvale General stock the 1 mg/mL 5 mL vial labeled by Hospira, Inc. (NDC 00409230505). Current days-on-hand range from 9.9 to 18.8 days across sites and presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1064827 at the Hospira plant (FEI 1925262) ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, 596 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1106244 at the Pfizer India plant ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, 209 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to the Pfizer India plant on 2020-03-25, 8 days before the shortage posting.

Our position: We have sufficient inventory to support internal transfers that keep each site above a two-week supply. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 6 vials of 1 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale East to Corvale General — approved by pharmacy director with controlled-substance transfer record (Schedule III-V).
2. Transfer 17 vials of 1 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director with controlled-substance transfer record (Schedule III-V).
3. Evaluate purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Belcher Pharmaceuticals, LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Civica, Inc. — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
